labels.label: fold_garment
labels.description: Folding a garment or piece of fabric, in whole or in part: fold in half, fold sleeves/sides/hem/bottom inward or upward, fold into a square/rectangle/strip, or any additional fold of an already-folded item. The dominant action in the dataset.

labels.label: smooth_garment
labels.description: Smoothing, flattening, straightening, spreading, or laying a garment flat (e.g. smoothen, smooth out wrinkles, flatten, straighten, spread on table/bed) to prepare or finish it, without folding it.

labels.label: adjust_garment
labels.description: Repositioning, aligning, arranging, rotating, or otherwise nudging a garment in place on the surface without folding, smoothing, flipping, picking up, or placing it elsewhere. Use for generic 'adjust'/'reposition'/'rotate'/'move on table' actions.

labels.label: flip_garment
labels.description: Flipping, turning over, inverting, or turning inside out a garment or folded item to expose the other side.

labels.label: unfold_garment
labels.description: Unfolding, opening up, spreading out a previously folded garment, or unzipping/unbuttoning to open it up (as opposed to fastening). Reverses a fold.

labels.label: pick_up_garment
labels.description: Picking up, grabbing, lifting, retrieving, or pulling a garment or fabric out of a pile/basket/rack/drawer/washer as the primary action (not immediately placing it elsewhere).

labels.label: place_garment
labels.description: Placing, moving, stacking, or setting a garment down onto a stack, pile, table, shelf, drawer, bed, closet, or other surface (not into a bag/box/container).

labels.label: clean_garment
labels.description: Cleaning, de-linting, or removing debris from a garment: rolling/using a lint roller, brushing with a toothbrush, wiping, removing lint/threads/tape, or spraying with water.

labels.label: iron_garment
labels.description: Ironing or pressing a garment with an iron, including picking up or setting down the iron as part of the ironing motion.

labels.label: open_container
labels.description: Picking up, opening, unzipping, or preparing an empty bag, box, or container (plastic bag, storage bag, box, drawer, pouch) to receive a garment.

labels.label: insert_in_container
labels.description: Inserting, packing, or putting a folded garment into a bag, box, or container, including sealing/closing/zipping the container and placing the packaged item onto a stack.

labels.label: fasten_garment
labels.description: Fastening or closing parts of a garment: buttoning, zipping up, tying drawstrings/belts, or otherwise securing fasteners (the opposite of unfasten/unfold).

labels.label: hang_garment
labels.description: Hanging or unhanging a garment, or handling hangers and racks: hang shirt on rack, place garment on hanger, remove hanger from garment, pick up/place hanger.

labels.label: no_action
labels.description: No meaningful manipulation occurs in the segment (idle/empty).

labels.label: other_manipulation
labels.description: Rare or ambiguous manipulation that does not fit any other label: handling tools/tags (tag gun, label printer, tape dispenser, cards), pairing/sorting socks, moving non-garment objects, or otherwise unclassifiable actions.
